guidedProject.title: Multi-Step Interactive Wizard with Dynamic Tabs
guidedProject.description:
Build a two-step registration wizard while learning how state stays in the parent and how child components receive data and callbacks.

Learning sequence:
1. Understand state ownership.
2. Render the first step.
3. Move to the second step.
4. Go back without losing data.
5. Keep inputs controlled.
6. Add validation before allowing the next step.
7. Finish with a review step.

For the first guided milestone, focus only on navigation. Do not jump ahead to validation until the state transition is working.

milestones.instructions: Read App.jsx. `activeStep` or `activeTab` is the source of truth. The parent should change it; the child should call the callback.

codeStudio.title: Multi-Step Interactive Wizard with Dynamic Tabs
codeStudio.description:
Build a beginner-friendly multi-step form in multiple files. You will learn the relationship between parent state and child components.

Architecture:
App.jsx
├── TabNav.jsx
├── PersonalStep.jsx
└── PreferencesStep.jsx

The parent owns `activeTab` and `formData`. Child components receive values and callbacks through props. Navigation changes the active step, while inputs update the shared form object.

tasks.instruction: Verify TabNav component exists at src/components/TabNav.jsx.
Verify PersonalStep component exists at src/components/PersonalStep.jsx.
